title: ClassificationInputSchema
description: Standardized input representation for an invoice line item submitted to an ML or heuristic item classifier.

line_item_id.description: Unique identifier of the line item within the invoice or request context

raw_item_description.description: Unmodified text description of the product as extracted from document

unit.description: Unit of measure (e.g. PCS, PACK, KG, LTR), if available

platform.description: Delivery platform identifier (e.g. ZOMATO, SWIGGY_INSTAMART, BLINKIT, ZEPTO), if known
